rv.q: Mr. Garber fits the role as neatly as those silk pajamas fit him.
The results are a 'Present Laughter' without much laughter, indeed.
Kline may be the nimblest, most sophisticated comedian the American theatre has to offer, and the role of Garry fits him like one of his superbly tailored dressing gowns.
But it’s nowhere near as clever as Coward can be.

tn.cat: Best Scenic Design of a Play

cn.t: Critics applaud this elegant revival, praising Victor Garber's debonair performance as the self-absorbed matinee idol and the production's sparkling wit. The cast's evident joy proves infectious, making for frothy, sophisticated fun.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
